'''Janthir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who conquered a number of primitive [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Janthir allowed Imperial archaeologists to examine the plunder he took from the conquered worlds, and asked them to study an [[Unidentified Kwa artifact|artifact]] built by the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] that the archaeologists identified amongst the spoils.<ref name="Mission" />
